declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval under Rule 23(e). Counsel negotiated the settlement over three rounds. Our initial proposal sought a $34 million class fund and $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $29 million class fund and $6 million in fees and expenses. After further exchanges, Brightline accepted our proposal for a $30.5 million class fund and $6 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Fees were discussed from the first round, not only after class relief was agreed. Throughout the negotiations, the parties agreed that identified class members would receive payments automatically, without filing claims; Brightline would remain free to address the fee request; and any fees the Court declines to award would go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. In my judgment, the settlement provides substantial, promptly distributable relief in light of the risks of class certification and trial, the possibility of no recovery, and the likely two-to-three-year wait for trial. I ask the Court to preliminarily approve the settlement, subject to its independent review of the settlement and fee request.
